review_evidence: README identifies LeanAide as an AI-assisted Lean development and autoformalization system with translation, theorem/definition generation and proof-support interfaces.
The 311 current-primary files include core translation/elaboration APIs, tactic/data-generation modules, generated CodeGen formal statements, client examples and experimental formal developments.

Scratch and generated/test-named material was not excluded wholesale: direct inspection found substantive formal content such as a proved modular-exponentiation development in Scratch/PowerMod.lean and theorem/examples intermixed with elaborator experiments in Scratch/Fiddle.lean, so a path-name blacklist would create false negatives.
summary: Retain LeanAide’s formal/metaprogramming corpus, generated formal statements, experiments and scratch developments; naming alone does not prove any large subtree content-lossless.
